title: OpenCode chart fence
description: Body of a ```chart fenced block. A JSON object; one chart per block. 'type' is strongly recommended: when it is missing the shape of the data decides (slices -> pie, columns+rows -> table, rows -> heatmap, values/series -> bar). Unknown keys are ignored, and the renderer prints a muted footer when it had to rename a key, treat a value as 0, or guess the type.

width.description: Chart columns. Clamped to the available terminal content width.

height.description: Total rows for the chart, including title, labels, legend and notes. A plot-only family takes plotHeight for the plot area.

plotHeight.description: Rows for the plot area. Overrides the plot part of height; the chrome (title, labels, legend, notes) sits outside it.

theme.description: Colour set. Defaults to the terminal theme.

mosaic.description: Sub-cell glyph set. Default sextant (Unicode 13); octant is finer but Unicode 16, so only use it when the font is known to carry it.

labels.description: Category names or axis names, in data order.

oneOf.description: Candles as [open, high, low, close] per period.

slices.description: Pie and donut data, as [label, value] pairs.

stacked.description: Bars and areas: series stack instead of grouping.

normalized.description: Bars and areas: 100% of each label's total. The legend still prints the real totals.

showPercent.description: Single-series bars: print the share beside each value. (The old name 'percent' is accepted and renamed with a note.)

boundaryColor.description: Colour of the seam between two series. Defaults to the theme background. (The old name 'gap' is accepted and renamed with a note.)

zero.description: Line, area, scatter and candle: set false for a narrow range so the data fills the plot. Bars always include zero.

textured.description: Bars: a hatch pattern per series, for monochrome terminals.

bins.description: Histogram: bin count. Default is the square-root rule, capped at 30.

start.description: Waterfall: the running total before the first delta.

total.description: Waterfall: draw the closing total bar.

totalLabel.description: Waterfall: name of the total bar.

up.description: Candles and waterfall: colour of an upward move.

down.description: Candles and waterfall: colour of a downward move.

headers.description: Heat map columns. (The old name 'columns' is accepted and renamed with a note.)

cellWidth.description: Heat map: columns per cell. Defaults to the widest header plus one.

low.description: Heat map and table heat columns: colour for the lowest value.

high.description: Heat map and table heat columns: colour for the highest value.

valueLabels.description: Heat map and bars: print each value.

columns.description: Table: column definitions. Each entry is a name or {label, key, type, width, color, align}.

items.description: Treemap: {label, value} leaves, or {label, children} groups.
Kanban: flat cards; the column is decided by 'column', 'status' or 'list'.

max.description: Radar and gauge: the full-scale value, so two charts are comparable.

filled.description: Radar: fill the polygon even with several series.

spokes.description: Radar and pie: draw the axis lines.

target.description: Gauge and progress: a marker on the track.

track.description: Horizontal bars: show the unfilled track.

big.description: Scatter: double the marker so single points stay visible.

note.description: Histogram: print the sample count and bin width under the chart.
